sourceTitle: Rheem super high efficiency condensing tankless water heater use and care manual AP21820 Rev 04 (condensing direct vent; 199,900, 180,000, 157,000 and 120,000 Btu/hr)
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not try to light the water heater, do not touch an electrical switch, and do not use a phone in the building. Leave and call your gas supplier from outside. Use and care AP21820 says not to repair electrical wiring, gas piping, the remote, burners, vent connectors or other safety devices. Those repairs belong to a qualified service technician.
displayPattern: Remote or built-in controller on a super high efficiency condensing direct-vent tankless covered by use and care AP21820 Rev 04. The temperature-rise chart in that manual names RTGH-95DVL-3, RTGH-90DVL-3, RTGH-84DVL-3 and RTGH-68DVL-3.
diySteps: Turn off the hot-water faucets, press POWER to turn the heater off, wait about 5 minutes, then turn it back on and open a hot faucet. If the code is still there, unplug the heater for about 30 seconds, plug it back in, and check the display again
Turn the heater off. The chart says to contact a dealer or a qualified service technician
causes: The chart also says the flushing procedure may need to be repeated when lime and scale buildup is excessive
proAdvice: Code 71 is the gas solenoid circuit. The same row says a flush may have to be repeated for heavy scale. That work belongs to a qualified technician. Code 1L is the separate lime-deposit code.
